items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Lois St. John, she was here not long ago, she manipulated the thing and they gave a surprise birthday party for me at Birdland

ctx.x: I was playing at the Sunnyside Horseshoe and Lois St. John, she was here not long ago, she manipulated the thing and they gave a surprise birthday party for me at Birdland and Billie Holiday, that was the last time I saw her alive. Billie came in and she looked so bad, but she came over to me and says, baby, I don't feel so good--she called everybody baby, I don't feel so good, but I'm going to sing for you and she got up and sang.
How well did you know her; had you known her that well?
